# toggle-group

Applies one registry toggle treatment to native Toggle controls in a caller-owned ControlGroup.

## Install

```sh
python3 Scripts/install.py toggle-group --destination <your-target-dir>
```

Then add package https://github.com/mangobyte-dev/swiftui-ui-registry.git (from 0.1.0 up to the next minor version) and link product SwiftUIRegistryFoundations

## Usage

```swift
@State private var bold = false
@State private var italic = false

ControlGroup {
    Toggle("Bold", systemImage: "bold", isOn: $bold)
    Toggle("Italic", systemImage: "italic", isOn: $italic)
}
.registryToggleGroup()
```

## Details

- Kind: component
- Version: 0.1.1
- Platforms: iOS 18.0+
- Installs in order: [button](button.md) 0.1.1, [toggle](toggle.md) 0.1.0, [toggle-group](toggle-group.md) 0.1.1
- Accessibility contract:
  - Retains each native Toggle's independent state and activation behavior.
  - Keeps all selection bindings caller-owned.
  - Requires accessible labels for icon-only toggles.
  - Inherits Dynamic Type, enabled state, control size, and layout direction.
